checks.description: Azure Network Security Group rules must not allow unrestricted inbound access from any source (0.0.0.0/0 or *)
checks.impact: Allowing unrestricted inbound access exposes resources such as SSH (port 22) and RDP (port 3389) to brute-force and exploitation from the entire internet
checks.resolution: Set source_address_prefix to a specific IP range or service tag instead of '*' or 'Internet' on all Allow inbound azurerm_network_security_rule resources
checks.errorMessage: Azure NSG rule allows inbound traffic from any source (source_address_prefix must not be '*')
